LabNoise.description:
Declared (hypothetical) iid qubit channel between minting and verification.

Readout error is deliberately absent: the lane-B register verifier has no classical readout
stage, and a readout flip in the secret basis cannot be expressed as a channel on the note
without knowing the secret.

get.description:
Index of experiment records in the RecordStore registry, newest first (may be empty).

Each record passes the provenance gate: unverifiable or fixture records are served as SYNTHETIC.
Headline numbers (SDP bracket, reproduced QBER, matched-topology latency) with source files and evidence.
Display labels for every EvidenceKind, CertificateStatus and API status.
Security games W1..C1 with transcribed closed-form bounds and their theorem / proof-obligation anchors.
API and schema versions, git sha, lane package probe and the research-platform disclaimer.
Gate and task status read verbatim from project/TRACKER.yaml (lead-maintained).
Registered protocol ids, their games, and whether a merged lane implements them.
Research library index: papers, theorems, obligations, datasets, corrections, novelty audit.
One research entry with every field of its source record and related entries (404 if unknown).
